landing.faq.buy.a: No. Every feature is there from the first song: no purchases, no subscriptions and no ads.
landing.faq.buy.q: Do I have to buy anything?
landing.faq.microphone.a: The microphone of your phone or computer is enough. Headphones help: you hear the song, and the microphone hears only you.
landing.faq.recordings.a: No. Your songs and recordings stay on your device and are never sent anywhere.
landing.faq.songs.a: Any song you have as a file on your phone or computer, such as MP3, M4A, FLAC or WAV.
landing.faq.start.a: Yes. Start with a song you love: listen to how the singer does it, sing one line, and see how close you came.
landing.faq.start.q: I have never sung before. Is it for me?
landing.faq.students.a: Yes, every student gets everything. Tell us how you teach, so that the app fits your lessons.
landing.faq.students.q: I teach singing. Can my students use it?
landing.faq.title: Questions
landing.faq.try.a: Yes. Bring a song to this page: its first five minutes come apart into the singer, the backing vocals and the music, right in your browser.
landing.faq.try.q: Can I try it before installing?
landing.hero.lead: Hear the singer's voice on its own, sing over the music, and see your voice next to theirs, line by line. Your voice never leaves your phone or computer.
landing.hero.title: Learn to sing the songs
landing.join.lead: Musetric is not released yet. Soon you can download it here for your phone or computer.
landing.join.title: Be one of the first to sing with it
landing.promises.everything.text: Every feature from the first song. No purchases, no subscriptions, no ads.
landing.promises.everything.title: Everything, for everyone
landing.promises.label: What Musetric promises
landing.promises.open.text: Anyone can see how it works and what it is building next.
landing.promises.open.title: Made in the open
landing.promises.voice.text: Your songs and your recordings never leave your device. No account to create.
landing.promises.voice.title: Your voice stays yours
landing.steps.compare.text: Your voice is drawn next to the singer's: where you went flat or sharp, where they slid into a note and you did not.
landing.steps.compare.title: See where you differ
landing.steps.fit.text: Move the song up or down until it sits in your voice, slow a hard phrase down, or sing an octave below or above the singer.
landing.steps.fit.title: Make it fit your voice
landing.steps.line.text: The lyrics follow the song word by word. Loop one line, sing it again and again, and keep your best try.
landing.steps.line.title: Sing it line by line
landing.steps.song.text: Any song you have as a file, on your phone or your computer. You learn on the music you actually want to sing.
landing.steps.song.title: Bring a song you love
landing.steps.stems.text: The lead vocal, the backing vocals and the music come apart. Hear exactly how a phrase is sung, then sing over the music without the voice.
landing.steps.stems.title: Hear the singer alone
landing.steps.title: How a song becomes yours
landing.teachers.class.text: Every student gets everything, with no account to create.
landing.teachers.class.title: For the whole class
landing.teachers.home.text: The student works on the same lines at home, at their own speed.
landing.teachers.home.title: Practice between lessons
landing.teachers.key.text: The music without the voice, moved to where the student sings, ready before the lesson starts.
landing.teachers.key.title: The song in the student's key
landing.teachers.lead: Bring a student's song to the lesson ready to work on, and let them practise the same song at home.
landing.teachers.line.text: Play one phrase of the lead vocal alone, then the student's try next to it.
landing.teachers.line.title: The singer's line to point at
landing.teachers.title: Show the line, don't just describe it.
landing.teachers.write: Tell us what your lessons need

privacy.browser.downloads: To take a song apart, your browser downloads the model that does it from Hugging Face and the runtime that runs it from jsDelivr, once, and keeps them. Like any website, these services receive your IP address and the names of the files your browser asks for, under their own privacy policies; they receive nothing of your song.
privacy.browser.song: When you try Musetric on this website, the song you choose is taken apart in your browser, on your device. It is never uploaded. Your browser keeps the song and its parts until you choose another song or delete them.
